changes:
Aurora's desktop icons (aurora-logo-icon and start-here in hicolor, system-logo-white.png) and the About this System branding, as alarm-aurora's aurora-logos installs them.
About this System names the system "Aurora, based on Debian testing".
notes: The images are alarm-aurora's, byte for byte (provenance.json names their fedora-aurora origin). kcm-about-distrorc says Name=Aurora, based on Debian testing where alarm-aurora says Aurora Alarm. Debian's desktop-base owns /etc/xdg/kcm-about-distrorc (Debian logo, Version=forky/sid), so this package Replaces desktop-base to take that one conffile over; dpkg keeps it when desktop-base is upgraded.
